# Grok Bot Plays

> Unofficial, edited catalog of real Grok Bot "plays": setups, routines and workflows people have publicly shared, each linked to its original source (X posts, GitHub, LinkedIn, YouTube, x.ai docs, blogs). Not affiliated with xAI. Nothing for sale. English at the root, Chinese under /zh/.

## Main pages

- [Home: latest plays](https://grokbotplays.com/): browse all English plays
- [Categories](https://grokbotplays.com/categories/): plays grouped by scenario
- [Install Grok Bot](https://grokbotplays.com/install/): how to get started
- [About](https://grokbotplays.com/about/): what is included and how entries are chosen
- [Submit a play](https://grokbotplays.com/submit/): suggest a new play
